Wrap.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.

MOVE-A09.scope: Ten attacks with defense/critical/weather rules: ignores defenses, Special damage resisted with Defense without changing category, existing AlwaysCrit and Weather Ball type/+2 weather dice. Ordinary completion retains held-item effects; historical adoption stays unchanged.

Sacred Sword.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Ignore Defenses.

Psyshock.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.

Psystrike.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. This Move is resisted with the Foe's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.

Frost Breath.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. This Move is always considered to be a Critical hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.

Storm Throw.effect: Single Target. This Move is always considered to be a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.

Wicked Blow.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Fist Move. If the Accuracy Roll is successful, this Move becomes a Critical Hit.

Flower Trick.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. This Move is always considered to be a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.

Kinesis.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.

Sand Attack.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.

Smokescreen.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.

Mud Slap.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.

Spacial Rend.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Unique. If successful, reduce 5 Success from all Accuracy rolls of the Target. Whole scene duration.

Leaf Tornado.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.

Mud Bomb.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Die to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy rolls of the Target.

Muddy Water.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of those affected.

Night Daze.effect: Single Target. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy rolls of the foe. Outside of battle, obscuring effects last for a whole scene.

Octazooka.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.

MOVE-A11.scope: Four explicitly stacking stat cards: Sharpen, Syrup Bomb, Luster Purge and Mist Ball. Each named stat effect stacks to three; exact Chance pools, live reflection/protection and standard other-move nonstacking channels remain. Scene-local counters clear with modifiers or departure.

Sharpen.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 times.

Syrup Bomb.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 Times.

Luster Purge.effect: Single Target. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce Sp. Defense by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 times per Target.

Mist Ball.effect: Single Target. Unique. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Special by 1. *This Effect can be stacked up to 3 times per target.

MOVE-A12.scope: Rapid Spin raises user Dexterity and clears its ongoing damage/Leech Seed and its side hazards/terrains. Ice Spinner and Steel Roller remove active terrains; Steel Roller requires a terrain at declaration. Cleanup retains opposing side effects and pure scene Blocking, including shared/global scopes.

Rapid Spin.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.

Ice Spinner.effect: Single Target. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.

Steel Roller.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Can't be used if there is no Active Terrain (Grassy Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) on the Battlefield. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.

MOVE-A13.scope: Seven source/context attacks. Current source main/secondary typing determines four move types; Terrain Pulse takes the active applicable terrain type and two dice; Psyblade gains two dice in Electric Terrain; Acrobatics loses two pool dice while holding an item. Existing STAB, immunity, resistance, snapshots and ability conversions retained.

Acrobatics.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Held Item, Reduce 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.

Ivy Cudgel.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible Otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.

Raging Bull.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible, otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances and STAB accordingly.

Multi-Attack.effect: Single Target. Unique. This Move's type will change to match the User's Main Type.

Revelation Dance.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.

Psyblade.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. *If Electric Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.

Terrain Pulse.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if there is a Terrain active in the Battlefield. Change this Move's Type to match that of a currently active Terrain (ie Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, etc.).

MOVE-A14.scope: Five stat/Blocking cards. Belly Drum rolls half current HP as typeless self-damage dice; Clangorous Soul half total HP rounded down; Fillet Away deals two self damage. No Retreat blocks the user and Octolock blocks the target independently of protected stat changes. Ordinary indirect protection and stat channels retained.

Belly Drum.effect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strength by 3.

Clangorous Soul.effect: Target Self. User deals Damage Dice to itself equal to Half of its Total HP rounded down. Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.

Fillet Away.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 Damage to the User. Increase the User's Strength, Dexterity and Special by 2.

No Retreat.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

Octolock.effect: Single Target. Block. Reduce by 1 the Target's Defense and Sp. Defense.

MOVE-A15.scope: Taunt prevents Support Pokemon moves for four rounds while preserving Support Maneuvers. Throat Chop prevents Sound moves for the scene across switching. Imprison prevents foes from using the active caster's current known moves and ends on caster departure/faint. Authority, immunity and GM clearing remain explicit.

Taunt.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.

Throat Chop.effect: Single Target. The target cannot use any "Sound Based" Move. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.

Imprison.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.

MOVE-A16.scope: Four history-dependent moves with saved accepted Pokemon move attempts and entry rounds. Disable selects only the last recorded target move and replaces its prior disable; Torment excludes last-round moves for four rounds; Blood Moon/Gigaton Hammer fail if used last round, including Clash attempts. Gigaton Hammer's discretionary Steel bonus remains an explicit GM pool modifier.

Disable.effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.

Torment.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot use any of the Moves it used during the last Round. Duration 4 Rounds.

Blood Moon.effect: Single Target. If this Move was used on the previous Round, it fails (Clashing counts as using the Move.)

Gigaton Hammer.effect: Single Target. Lethal. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round. *This Move may deal 2 Extra Damage Dice to Steel-Type Pokemon at Storyteller's Discretion.

Mighty Cleave also bypasses Force Fields; Hyperspace Hole/Fury retain existing Force Field bypass; Hyper Drill still takes applicable Force Field reduction. Hyperspace Fury reduces user Defense by one. Other weather/environment reductions remain.

Hyper Drill.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ignore Shield Moves active on the Foe or their side of the field.

Hyperspace Hole.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Unique. Ignore Defenses. Ignore Shield Moves and Force Field.

Mighty Cleave.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Ignore Shield Moves & Force Fields active on the foe or their side of the field.

Hyperspace Fury.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Ignores the effect of any Force Field or Shield Move active on the foe's side. Reduce the User's Defense by 1.

MOVE-A18.scope: Nine range/immunity attacks. Existing specific charge vulnerabilities retained; canonical Freeze Dry resolves the Dive card's Freeze-Dry spelling and is super-effective against Water. Origin Pulse/Precipice Blades hit hidden charging targets and ignore immunity to their printed damage type. Smack Down/Thousand Arrows remove Ground immunity for the scene, ending on departure. Weather activation guards, Shields and Force Fields remain independent.

Earthquake.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.

Gust.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.

Sky Uppercut.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.

Surf.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.

Freeze Dry.effect: Single Target. Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive" this Move hits anyways.

related_sources.name: Dive
related_sources.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Scald/ Surf/ Whirlpool/ Freeze-Dry/ Sheer Cold. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to move underwater carrying someone without risk of drowning.

Origin Pulse.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's immunity to Water-Type Damage. If a Target is "Out of Range" due to using a Move, this Move hits anyways.

Precipice Blades.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's Immunity to Ground-Type Damage. If a Target is "Out of Range" due to using any Move, this Move hits anyways.

Smack Down.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.

Thousand Arrows.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's immunity to Ground. Remove the immunity to Ground-Type Moves of those affected. Whole Scene Duration.

Strength.effect: Single Target. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's lifting capacity.

Fling.effect: Single Target. Ranged. *If the User is holding an Item, Add up to 4 dice to the damage pool. User loses its Held Item. See p. 530

Natural Gift.effect: Single Target. Ranged. The User loes its held berry. *The Type of this Move changes according to the berry used. See more on p. 530

MOVE-A20.scope: Four partner attacks: Baddy Bad/Glitzy Glow create four-round own-side Physical/Special Force Fields only after dealing damage; Pika Papow adds Happiness dice capped at five; Zippy Zap retains guaranteed Critical and Reaction 2. Current encounters also correct the three already-routed partner moves' final-stage guard using forward ordinary evolution, excluding From/Mega/Form/same-Dex edges. Historical guard behavior is preserved. Baddy Bad follows Single Target prose rather than its inconsistent battlefield Target metadata.

Baddy Bad.effect: Single Target. After dealing damage, activate a Force Field against Physical Damage with a Duration of 4 Rounds on the User's side of the Field. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.

Glitzy Glow.effect: Single Target. After dealing damage, activate a Force Field against Special Damage with a Duration of 4 Rounds on the User's side of the Field. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.

Pika Papow.effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point of Happiness on the User. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.

Zippy Zap.effect: Single Target. Reaction 2. This Move is always considered a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.

MOVE-A21.scope: Tailwind gives own-side Dexterity +2 through the non-additive move stat channel for four rounds, including entrants; Fairy Lock Blocks everyone on the battlefield for one round. Field duration persists without the caster; ordinary Run Away and GM switch override rules apply. Active timed fields cannot restart their counter by recasting (RULING p.77).

Tailwind.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.

MOVE-A22.scope: Spider Web installs a scene-long foe-side entry hazard. New entrants receive scene Blocking, including flying targets; current occupants are unaffected. Heavy-Duty Boots and Run Away retain their separate protections. Hazard cleanup removes the field, while already applied Blocking follows its own lifetime.

Spider Web.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

MOVE-A23.scope: Complete ordinary Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade and Dynamax Cannon damage with their existing printed attributes; Dynamax/Gigantamax bonuses and lethal wounds remain excluded. Grassy Glide gains its printed Reaction 1 only while applicable Grassy Terrain is active, then finishes after ordinary damage.

Behemoth Bash.effect: Single Target. Unique. *If the Foe is under the effects of Dynamax/Gigantamax, This Move becomes Lethal and add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.

Behemoth Blade.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Unique. *If the Foe is under the effects of Dynamax/Gigantamax, This Move becomes Lethal and add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.

Dynamax Cannon.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is under the effects of Dynamax, this Move becomes Lethal and you add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.

Grassy Glide.effect: Single Target. *If Grassy Terrain is active, this Move has Reaction 1.

MOVE-A24.scope: First Impression is allowed only in the first round its deployed user can act: max(saved deployment round, available_round). User ruling 5 November 2026. Actual deployment history is saved; missed eligibility does not postpone the window. Reaction 2 remains. Missing saved entry history requires explicit review; historical encounters retain their prior manual scope.

First Impression.effect: Single Target. Reaction 2. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. From the second round on, it will fail automatically.
First Impression.ruling: User chose first round it can act, 5 November 2026.

MOVE-A25.scope: Aura Wheel raises its user Dexterity by one through the existing damaging-stat channel, retaining Hunger Switch Full-Belly Electric/Hangry Dark typing, including the frozen damage/type pipeline. Existing protection, Sheer Force and stat abilities apply. Historical encounters retain manual effect completion.

Aura Wheel.effect: Single Target. Increase the user's Dexterity by 1. If the user of this Move is in "Hangry Form" this Move is considered Dark-Type.

MOVE-A26.scope: Mud Sport and Water Sport create non-refreshable four-round global fields. Resolved damaging Electric/Fire moves have Power zero and cannot deal super-effective damage; resistance, immunity, STAB and independent extra dice remain. Damage and effect-immunity checks share the same sport-adjusted matchup. Historical encounters retain their previous behavior.

Mud Sport.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Electric-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.

Water Sport.effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.

MOVE-A27.scope: Tar Shot reduces target Dexterity by one using ordinary stat protection/reflection, and independently makes damaging Fire-type moves super-effective against it for the scene. Existing type/ability immunity remains; Water Sport still suppresses super-effective damage. Recall/faint clears the scene mark. Historical encounters retain manual resolution.

Tar Shot.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1. For the Whole Scene, Fire-Type Moves deal Super-Effective damage against the Target.

MOVE-A28.scope: Victory Dance grants Strength/Defense +1 and one additional die on non-ranged Physical damage pools. Autotomize grants Dexterity +2 and halves current-form encounter weight. Their separate scene auxiliary effects do not stack on recast, clear on recall/faint, and use existing frozen pools and authoritative weight profiles.

Victory Dance.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense. Add 1 Die to the User's Damage Pool for all Non-Ranged Physical Attacks.

Autotomize.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2. Halve the User's weight.

MOVE-A29.scope: Charge stores two move-channel damage dice for the next damaging resolved Electric move. Electric Support moves preserve it. A damaging attempt consumes the stored charge even on a miss; a successful attempt binds it to the complete cast, including area recipients and multi-hits. Existing ability charge remains a separate channel. Recall/faint clears unspent charge; saved casts and undo retain their state. Clash attempts also consume Charge, while their fixed damage has no damage pool to increase. Newly adopting encounters use the sport/Tar Shot-adjusted matchup and Wonder Guard for Clash damage as well.

Charge.effect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.

MOVE-A30.scope: Laser Focus prepares the next Physical/Special move: if its accuracy has at least five successes above that attempt's required action difficulty, ignore defenses. A damaging attempt consumes it even on a miss; Support preserves it. The condition is per recipient for area casts and survives saved casts, knockout continuation and undo. Critical damage, Shields, Force Fields and type/ability immunity remain independent; Clash has fixed damage without defenses.

Laser Focus.effect: Target Self. If the next Physical or Special Move the user performs gets 5 more successes required on the Accuracy Roll, ignore the Target's defenses on the Damage roll.

MOVE-A31.scope: Dragon Cheer gives allies in range High Critical on Physical/Special moves and raises Strength/Special by one only for allies currently Dragon-typed. It preserves the supplied All Allies targeting pattern, including its user requirement; no extra self-exclusion is invented. Stat protection and Contrary/Simple affect the stat clauses independently of High Critical. Recast does not stack; target recall/faint ends the scene effect.

Dragon Cheer.effect: Target Allies in Range. All Physical and Special Moves of the Allies now have the "High Critical" Added Effect. *If an Ally is a Dragon-Type, Increase their Strength and Special by 1.

MOVE-A32.scope: Shelter grants Defense/Sp. Defense +1 and removes one success from foes' move Accuracy when targeting its user. The success penalty shares the strongest move/item accuracy-loss channel with existing accuracy drops and Bright Powder; printed move difficulty and ability penalties remain separate. Keen Eye and Zoom Lens retain their reviewed behavior. Main and reaction area rolls save individual target results. Recall/faint clears the scene auxiliary.

Shelter.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Foes when targeting the User.

MOVE-A33.scope: Clear Smog resets the five Attributes; Haze and Freezy Frost reset Attributes plus numeric Traits. User ruling 6 November 2026: retain active passive bonuses, clear applied move and triggered-ability changes. Applied item/copy grants are cleared; active fields, passive held/weather/conditional abilities, permanent stats and non-stat tags remain. Curious Medicine adopts the same reset. Freezy Frost uses the reviewed final-evolution guard.

Clear Smog.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Reset all Increased or Reduced Attributes on the Foe.

Haze.effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.

Freezy Frost.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits the Target may have. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.

MOVE-A34.scope: Foresight and Odor Sleuth prevent their marked target from Evading that caster and bypass innate Ghost versus Normal/Fight immunity in both attack directions for that caster-target pair. Sweet Scent prevents affected foes from Evading any moves. Scene marks clear on target recall/faint; saved detection pairs preserve damage-linked effects through knockout. Accuracy, Clash and unrelated type/ability immunity remain independent. Outside-battle tracking/attraction remains narrative.

Foresight.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa.

Odor Sleuth.effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa. Out of battle, Add successes of this Move to any roll for Tracking targets.

Sweet Scent.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.

MOVE-A35.scope: Telekinesis prevents Evade and grants Ground-move immunity for two rounds, using its supplied Hovering metadata for grounded-field eligibility. Gravity, Iron Ball, explicit grounding, Mold Breaker and Ground-immunity bypass retain their established precedence; suppressing the Ground clause does not remove the no-Evade clause. Recast cannot restart an active timer; recall/faint clears the mark. Newly adopting Clash calculations also honor explicit Ground-immunity bypass.

Telekinesis.effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.

related_sources.effect: If a foe Pokemon has a Type, an immunity, or an Ability that would prevent this Pokemon from dealing Damage with a Move, ignore it.
related_sources.reason: Existing Mold Breaker wording explicitly bypasses a foe immunity that prevents move damage.
related_sources.name: Mold Breaker

MOVE-A36.scope: Host rolls one die before damage; its face is the Power for that saved cast. Preserve the JSON Special damage stat and Dragon type. No invented power table.

Fickle Beam.effect: Single Target Before you roll damage, Roll 1 die to determine this Move's Power.

MOVE-A37.scope: False Swipe move damage cannot reduce a conscious recipient below one HP. Apply after damage reductions and independently of target survival items; decoy damage and later unrelated damage remain separate. Includes ordinary and Clash paths.

False Swipe.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. This Move's Damage can't make the Target go below 1 HP.

MOVE-A38.scope: Resolve the entire attempted area cast before self-fainting, including misses, immunity and Evasion. Misty Explosion adds four pool dice while applicable Misty Terrain is active. Damp recognizes exact catalog Self Destruct. Lethal wound automation remains excluded.

Explosion.effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.

Self Destruct.effect: Area Move. Lethal. Ranged. The User faints.

related_sources.name: Damp
related_sources.effect: No one in the field will be able to use the moves: Self-Destruct, Explosion, Misty Explosion, Mind Blown, and Burn Up while this Pokemon is in the field. The Ability Aftermath does not activate if this Pokemon is in the field.
related_sources.reason: Ability prose uses Self-Destruct; exact move JSON Name is Self Destruct.

Misty Explosion.effect: Area Attack. Lethal. The User faints after using this Move. *If Misty Terrain is active, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.

MOVE-A39.scope: Magic Powder replaces current target typing with Psychic for the scene or until the target leaves battle. Recasting replaces rather than stacks. Preserve sheet species, saved pending typing, existing Support reflection/protection, Powder immunity and held-item/ability protections.

Magic Powder.effect: Single Target. Powder Move. Change the target's Type to Psychic.

related_sources.name: Overcoat
related_sources.effect: This Pokemon won't recieve damage from Hail or Sandstorm weather. This Pokémon is immune to the added effects of Powder Moves.

MOVE-A40.scope: Magnet Rise grants scene Ground-move immunity and the supplied Float condition, ending on recall/faint. Gravity, Iron Ball, explicit grounding and Ground-immunity bypass retain established precedence. No added type or no-Evade clause. Recast does not stack.

Magnet Rise.effect: Target Self. The User gains Immunity against Ground-Type Moves. Whole Scene Duration

MOVE-A41.scope: Ion Deluge converts resolved Normal-type Physical/Special damage to Electric battlefield-wide for the scene, persisting after caster departure. Successful Plasma Fists converts only its user Normal-type moves, including Support, for the scene until recall/faint. Recast does not stack. Conversion follows other resolved typing and precedes sport suppression. Optional saved source marks preserve pending damage typing.

Ion Deluge.effect: Target Battlefield. Damage from Normal-Type Moves will be considered to be Electric-Type. Whole Scene Duration.

Plasma Fists.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. If successful, all Normal-Type Moves of the User will be considered Electric-Type. Whole Scene Duration.

MOVE-A42.scope: Electrify converts damage of the target next Physical/Special attempt to Electric. Support preserves preparation; a damaging miss consumes it. Bind conversion to the complete saved cast, including area and Clash, then clear it. Recall/faint clears unspent preparation; pending casts retain bound conversion. Existing Support protection/reflection and Reaction 1 timing remain.

Electrify.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. All Damage of the Next Physical or Special Move the Target performs will become Electric-Type

MOVE-A43.scope: Accepted Accuracy failures of Jump Kick/Supercell Slam require four typeless crash dice; High Jump Kick requires five. Successful Accuracy, including a later immune hit, does not crash. Reuse the owned host-roll pending-crash phase and save its exact pool. Legacy Axe Kick remains four dice.

Jump Kick.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.

High Jump Kick.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 5 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.

Supercell Slam.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.

MOVE-A44.scope: Order Up captures the covered conscious allied Tatsugiri current exact form when the attack is declared, before taking the action clears Cover. After a successful non-immune attack, grant the user one Strength (orange/Curly), Defense (red/Droopy) or Dexterity (yellow/Stretchy). No extra species restriction on the user. Apply existing non-stacking stat channels and Simple/Contrary. Saved cast markers preserve the selected stat; fixed-damage Clash retains its established effect rules.

Order Up.effect: Single Target. Unique. If the User is giving cover to a #978 Tatsugiri Ally. Increase by 1 an Attribute depending on the Ally's color. *Orange - Strength *Red - Defense *Yellow - Dexterity

related_sources.name: Tatsugiri (Curly Form)
related_sources.description: These small dragon Pokémon are very cunning: they hide inside the mouths of Dondozo, then feign weakness to lure prey and order their partner to attack. Orange Tatsugiri focus on offensive tactics.
related_sources.reason: Exact source form and its colour determine the Order Up Attribute/Trait.

related_sources.name: Tatsugiri (Droopy Form)
related_sources.description: These small dragon Pokémon are very cunning: they hide inside the mouths of Dondozo, then feign weakness to lure prey and order their partner to attack. Red Tatsugiri focus on defensive tactics.
related_sources.reason: Exact source form and its colour determine the Order Up Attribute/Trait.

related_sources.name: Tatsugiri (Stretchy Form)
related_sources.description: These small dragon Pokémon are very cunning: they hide inside the mouths of Dondozo, then feign weakness to lure prey and order their partner to attack. Yellow Tatsugiri focus on speed tactics.
related_sources.reason: Exact source form and its colour determine the Order Up Attribute/Trait.

MOVE-A45.scope: Saved optional target Will resistance followed by a GM battle-ending decision. Successful resistance prevents ending; accepted ending uses normal persistence, transformations, equipment cleanup and rollback. Outside-battle narrative remains excluded.

Hold Hands.effect: Single Target. The battle may end at the Storyteller's discretion. Target may resist rolling their Will Score against the Accuracy of this Move. Out of battle, aid to reduce hostile intent.

MOVE-A46.scope: Committed Metronome category/Power dice using a saved GM category table, exact non-Unique template selection and a single-target copied cast retaining Insight + Perform. Shared template damage, added effects, charges, successive actions, normal costs and defenses are reused; wrapper identity is preserved for Gorilla Tactics and Choice items. No silent resampling. Unsupported template mechanics remain tracked by the full-card ledger.

Metronome.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Roll a die to determine Physical or Special category, roll a die to determine this Move's Power. The appearance, Type and added effects of this Move becomes the same of a Physical or Special Move of the same Power at Storyteller's Discretion.
Metronome.core_rule: RULING Copying Moves: original Accuracy is retained; Unique moves cannot be copied. The category die mapping is unspecified and requires a saved GM interpretation before rolling.

MOVE-A47.scope: Saved GM Type, Power and Unique target-ability ruling; Ignore Defenses, damage-immunity/shield/field/decoy bypass and no Clash. Added effects are applied with normal GM battle commands and recorded as mechanical consequences, or explicitly declared absent. Accuracy, action eligibility and the existing range model remain.

Judgment.effect: Single Target. Unique. Ignore Defenses. This Move's Type, Power and extra Added Effects are decided by Storyteller. If something would prevent this Move from dealing Damage, ignore it. This Move can't be Clashed.

MOVE-A48.scope: Thirteen stat operations. Splits and swaps replace scene base values (Strength, Dexterity, Special from the base sheet; Defense and Sp. Defense from the derived defenses), computed from current bases and rounded down for averages, until the scene ends or the combatant leaves battle; increases and reductions stay with their owner. Power Trick and Power Shift trade the user's own Strength/Defense and Special/Sp. Defense. Psych Up, Heart Swap, Topsy-Turvy and Spectral Thief act on applied move/stacking/copied changes and triggered-ability counters, not passive or field bonuses. Acupressure rolls two host dice for an unbiased draw among Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, Sp. Defense, Accuracy and Evasion pools (the one biased face pair is rerolled) and replaces its previous increase. Mystical Power raises the lowest of the five Attributes by 2 unless that score is already 6 or more; tied lowest Attributes require a saved owner choice. Spectral Thief steals target increases after reactions close and before damage. Ordinary Support protection, immunities and decoys apply to targeted cards.

Acupressure.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 one of the User's Attributes or Traits at Random (Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, Sp. Defense, Accuracy, Evasion). If this Move is used again, the previous Attribute increase is removed.

Mystical Power.effect: Target Self. Increase by 2 the User's lowest Attribute/Trait. If an Attribute/Trait Score is 6 or More, this effect fails. Different Attributes/Traits may be increased this way.

Guard Split.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's, rounded down.

Power Split.effect: Single Target. Average the User's Strength and Special with the Target's, rounded down.

Guard Swap.effect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's.

Power Swap.effect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Strength and Special with the Target's.

Speed Swap.effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Dexterity with the Target's.

Power Trick.effect: Target Self. Switch the User's Strength with their Defense and Special with their Sp. Defense.

Power Shift.effect: Target Self. Switch the User's Strength with its Defense and its Special with its Sp. Defense.

Psych Up.effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.

Heart Swap.effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Trait and Attribute Increases and Reductions with those on the Target's.

Topsy-Turvy.effect: Single Target. Increased Attributes on the Target become Reductions instead and vice versa.

Spectral Thief.effect: Single Target. Unique. Before the User deals damage with this Move, steal all Attribute Increases the Target may have. Reduced Attributes on the Target remain.

MOVE-A49.scope: Eight typing, accuracy and targeting cards. Conversion rolls two host dice for an even draw over the 18 types and replaces the user's main type (secondary kept) for the scene or until it leaves battle; Reflect Type copies a foe's current types, with a saved owner choice when several foes are active. Lock-On adds two automatic Accuracy successes to the user's next move; Mind Reader adds two unremovable successes to the user's next Accuracy or Evasion roll against its target. Miracle Eye lets the user's Psychic moves hit Dark types, prevents foes from Evading the user's moves and stops move, item and ability Accuracy reductions on the user for the scene; printed Low Accuracy and field effects still apply. Snipe Shot ignores redirection and cover. Moongeist Beam and Sunsteel Strike ignore type and ability immunities, shields, weather prevention and force-field reductions, and cannot be Clashed; defenses, cover, decoys and survival effects still apply. Sunsteel Strike's printed Single Target overrides its Foe's Battlefield metadata.

Conversion.effect: Target Self. Unique. Change the User's Main Type at random. Whole Scene Duration.

Reflect Type.effect: Target Self. Change the User's Type to match the one(s) of a foe. (ie Staryu is battle vs Charizard, their type will become Fire/Flying intead of Water) Whole Scene Duration.

Lock-On.effect: Target Self. The Next Move the User Performs has 2 automatic successes added on their Accuracy Roll.

Mind Reader.effect: Single Target. The User has 2 automatic and unremovable successes on the next Accuracy or Evasion Roll against the Target.

Miracle Eye.effect: Target Self. The User's Psychic-Type Moves ignore Dark-Type Immunity. Target cannot Evade the User's Moves. This Pokemon's Accuracy cannot be Reduced by Move's, Items or Abilities (ie Sand Attack, Bright Powder, etc.). Whole Scene Duration

Snipe Shot.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Ignore effects from Moves, Items or Abilities that would prevent this Move from targeting the foe.

Moongeist Beam.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. If anything on the foe's side would prevent this move from dealing damage (Pokemon Type, Abilities, Shield Moves, Weather or Force Fields) ignore it. This Move cannot be clashed.

Sunsteel Strike.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. If anything on the foe's side would prevent this move frm dealing (Pokemon Type, Abilities, Shield Moves, Weather or Force Fields), ignore it. This Move cannot be Clashed.

MOVE-A50.scope: Eight damage-calculation cards. Hidden Power's printed Type is Varies: the caster's owner saves its type per cast; it is always super-effective and ignores type immunity, and Unown may repeat it within a round (p.530). Photon Geyser, Tera Blast and Tera Starstorm print a Physical/Special category: the owner saves Physical (Strength vs Defense) or Special (Special vs Sp. Defense) per cast. Terastallization and Tera Types are not modelled, so the Tera type clauses never apply; Tera Starstorm still rolls two host dice per damaged target to replace its typing with one of the 18 types evenly. Flying Press adds the Flying matchup to its Fighting effectiveness. Foul Play uses the target's higher Strength/Special and the user's STAB. Techno Blast takes Fire, Ice, Water or Electric when a Genesect holds the matching Drive (no Drive items exist in the current catalog). Conversion 2 marks the user for the scene; each time Physical or Special damage reaches it, its owner may choose a type resisting that move, which replaces the main type (secondary kept).

Hidden Power.effect: Single Target. This Move will always deal Super-Effective Damage against the Target. If used by the Pokemon #201 Unown. See p. 530

Photon Geyser.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. This Move's Damage Pool, can be rolled with either Strength or Special Attribute, dealing Physical or Special Damage respectively. Choose whatever is most convenient for the user.

Tera Blast.effect: Single Target. *If the User is actively Terastallized, the Type of this Move changes to match that of the Tera-Type. This affects Weaknesses, Resistances and STAB accordingly.

Tera Starstorm.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Unique Move. *If the User is actively Terastallized, the Type of this Move changes to match that of the Tera-Type, this affects Weaknesses, Resistances and STAB accordingly. Change the type of those affected at random.

Flying Press.effect: Single Target. This move deals damage as if it was also Flying-Type.

Foul Play.effect: Single Target. S.T.A.B. of the User and the Strength/Special of the foe are used for this Move's Damage Pool.

Techno Blast.effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Genesect is performing this Move, this Move's type may change to: Fire, Ice, Water, or Electric depending on the Driver it has as Held Item.

Conversion 2.effect: Target Self. Unique. After being dealt damage by a Physical or Special Move, change the User's Main Type to a Type resistant to that Move. Whole Scene Duration.

MOVE-A51.scope: Nine history-dependent cards. Belch is refused unless the user ate a berry this round (recorded berry consumption or berry hits); its Beauty forfeit/restore clauses are outside battle. Last Resort is refused until every other known move has had a successful Accuracy roll in this battle. Poltergeist is refused unless the target holds an item or an item was consumed, used as medicine, recycled or harvested on the target's side. Ruination rolls damage dice equal to the target's total HP, ignoring defenses (formula pool, effectiveness kept) and is refused against a target it already damaged this battle. Lash Out adds 3 dice if one of the user's Attributes or Traits was lowered this round; Revenge adds 2 dice if the user lost HP earlier this round; Temper Flare and Stomping Tantrum add 2 dice when the user's previous move failed its Accuracy roll (Stomping Tantrum's Dig clause is the existing range rule). Fell Stinger raises the user's Strength by 2 when its damage faints the target; targeting an already fainted Pokemon is not possible in the engine. Missing<Social>Points Accuracy pools (Belch, Chilly Reception) count the social points given up: the social cap (5, or 7 for Champions) minus the current score. Chilly Reception also activates Snowy Weather for 4 rounds before its Switcher effect; its Cool forfeit clause is outside battle.

Belch.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. This Move can only be used if the User has eaten a berry/food during the same Round. Pokemon with this Move may forfeit their Beauty score completely. If the Pokemon forgets this Move, restore 1 Point to their Beauty Score.

Last Resort.effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.

Poltergeist.effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target is Holding an Item or if Items have been used on the Target's side of the field.

Ruination.effect: Single Target. Unique. Lethal. Roll Damage dice equal to the Target's Total HP. Ignore Defenses. This move will fail if the Target has been previously hit with this Move during the Battle.

Lash Out.effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if any of the user's Attributes/Traits was lowered this Round.

Revenge.effect: Single Target. *If the User has already received Damage this Round, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.

Temper Flare.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move is the User failed the Accuracy roll of the last Move it performed.

Stomping Tantrum.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if the User failed the Accuracy roll of the last Move it performed. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig", this Move hits anyways.

Chilly Reception.effect: Target Battlefield. Switcher Move For the User. Activate Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds. Pokemon with this Move may forfeit their Cool score completely. If the Pokemon forgets this Move, restore 1 Point to their Cool Score.

Fell Stinger.effect: Single Target. *If used against a fainted Target ot if the Target faints due to damage from this Move, Increase the User’s Strength by 2.

MOVE-A52.scope: Ten initiative, reaction and maneuver cards. After You moves its ally to the front and Quash its target to the back of the initiative order from the next round's start, for the scene; recasting by the same user moves its mark, Quash persists across switching and After You ends when its target leaves. Ambush can be cast before the first round's turns start: the target resists with Insight + Alert against the user's successes; otherwise the user takes one surprise action before turns start that the target cannot Evade or Clash, and these pre-initiative actions are refunded when turns start. Encore (not usable in consecutive rounds) makes a target that acted last round repeat that round's moves in order and on the same targets for the rest of the round, refusing other moves and anything beyond the sequence; repeated Evasions/Clashes are not forced. Sucker Punch and Thunderclap can only react to a Physical or Special move, with an owner-saved early (Reaction 6, default) or late (Late Reaction 1) timing. Grapple: the target resists with its better of Strength/Dexterity against the user's successes; otherwise it is Blocked and the user cannot act or react until it releases (free) or either leaves. Double Team and Minimize allow up to five Evasions per round instead of one per turn; Minimize also halves weight and makes the user vulnerable to Stomp. Chip Away removes those evasion effects from a target it damages.

After You.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. The Target will go First in the Initiative Order. If used again, the previous target reverts to their original Initiative order. Whole Scene Duration.

Quash.effect: Single Target. Target's will go last in the Initiative Order. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. If used again, the previous Target has their order in the initiative restored.

Ambush.effect: Single Target. Before the Battle starts, Target may resist by rolling: Insight + Alert and scoring the same or more Successes. The User has 1 Action before Initiatives are rolled in which the Target can't act. Other foes can still Evade or Clash during this time.

Encore.effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.

Sucker Punch.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Late Reaction 1. This Move may be used as a Reaction or as a Late Reaction at convenience of the User. *If this Move is not used to react against a Physical or Special Move it will fail.

Thunderclap.effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Late Reaction 1. This Move may be used as a Reaction or as a Late Reaction at convenience of the User. *If this Move is not used to react against a Physical or Special Move it will fail.

Grapple.effect: Single Target. Blocks. The Target may resist this Maneuver by rolling Strength or Dexterity and scoring the same or more Successes than the User. The User can't Act while Grappling. The User can release the Grapple at any point to act.

Double Team.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.

Minimize.effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round. Reduce the User's Height and Weight in half. The user is now Vulernable to: Stomp. Whole Scene Duration.

Chip Away.effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)

MOVE-A53.scope: Four allied contributions. Helping Hand gives its ally 2 extra dice on the next Accuracy roll and 2 extra dice on the next Physical/Special damage roll; recasting refreshes rather than stacks. Help Another is a command, not an ordinary cast: the helper spends an action and rolls the ally's intended move's Accuracy pool with its own scores as Chance dice; each 6 adds one die to the ally's next Accuracy roll, at most 3 helpers and 6 dice per action. Beat Up: while its damage is pending, up to 3 different active allies may each spend an action to join, adding 2 damage dice each. Round: while a Round's damage is pending, an active ally that knows Round may join; both combatants' Round damage pools gain 3 dice this round. Skill checks other than Accuracy are not modified.

Helping Hand.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.

Help Another.effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. Roll your Accuracy as if it were Chance dice. Add 1 die to the Accuracy Roll of your Ally for each Success (result of 6) obtained this way. Up to 3 Characters may attempt to help a single Action. Up to 6 Dice may be added this way.

Beat Up.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move for every ally Pokemon that spends an action in addition to this Move, up to 3 allies may join.

Round.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. *If the user and an ally are able to use Round. Both may choose to do it at the same time. If they do, add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of both Pokemon.

MOVE-A54.scope: Six delayed and damage-triggered cards. Future Sight and Doom Desire roll damage normally (existing shield, force-field and decoy bypass kept) but deal it when turns start next round; if the target has left, the combatant now in its slot, otherwise an active ally (by identity order), takes it. Doom Desire's discretionary extra effects stay with the GM. Rage: for the rest of the round, each Physical/Special hit by a foe raises the user's Strength by 1, stacking to 3. Destiny Bond: if the user faints to Physical/Special damage this round, the attacker's HP drops to 0; it fails when used in consecutive rounds. Pursuit marks a target it damages; if that target is later recalled, switched out (including by a Switcher) or uses Run Away, it takes 2 typeless damage once. Glaive Rush makes its user Vulnerable (existing +2 damage and barrier/Cover bypass) until the next Physical/Special move hits it.

Future Sight.effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.

Doom Desire.effect: Single Target. Unique. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Rund. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute decoys. If the target retires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies. Extra effects may be added at Storyteller's Discretion.

Rage.effect: Single Target. If a foe damages the User with a Physical or Special Move in the same round after using this Move. Increase the User's Strength by 1. This effect can stack up to 3 Times.

Destiny Bond.effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.

Pursuit.effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.

Glaive Rush.effect: Single Target. Lethal. The User is now Vulnerable to: The Next Physical or Special Move that targets them.

MOVE-A55.scope: Four trigger cards. Shell Trap is only a Late Reaction to a non-ranged Physical attack against its user; its damage can be rolled only after that attack damaged the user this round (otherwise the GM cancels it). Powder marks a target until it leaves battle: when it next declares a Fire move, it owes typeless damage dice equal to that move's Power, rolled with Resolve Powder (no defenses); the Fire move proceeds. Curse rolls half the user's current HP as typeless self-damage dice and gives the target a lasting Accuracy-success loss of 1 (shared strongest-loss channel) and one fewer damage success. Flame Burst: after it deals damage, the caster's owner may save up to two other foes; each takes one Fire-type die (1 damage on a success, adjusted by type matchup), ignoring defenses.

Shell Trap.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Late Reaction 3. This Move's damage is only rolled the next time the User is hit with a Non-Ranged Physical attack.

Powder.effect: Single Target. Powder Move. The next time the Target uses a Fire-Type Move, Roll Typeless Damage Dice equal to that Move's power, ignore defenses.

Curse.effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.

Flame Burst.effect: Single Target. After dealing damage, the User may roll 1 die of Fire-Type Damage against two other targets, ignoring defenses.

MOVE-A56.scope: Six battlefield cards. Fire Pledge (4 rounds, not refreshed while active): every grounded combatant on the battlefield, including entrants, receives the round-end ongoing roll of 2 Fire-type dice ignoring defenses (existing tick workflow). Water Pledge (4 rounds): every Chance pool gains 2 dice, as Serene Grace does. Grass Pledge lowers the Dexterity of those it affects by 1 and installs a non-stacking foe-side entry hazard that lowers grounded entrants' Dexterity by 1, like Sticky Web. Mist (4 rounds, user's side): other combatants cannot reduce the Attributes of its targets; earlier reductions remain; Screen Cleaner removes it. Lucky Chant (scene, user's side): one failed die of each Accuracy, reaction and check roll may be rerolled, sharing the Chance reroll (not additive with it), and critical hits grant no bonus dice against its targets; damage rolls are unchanged. Court Change swaps every side-scoped battlefield rule and entry hazard between the two sides, keeping durations; battles with more than two sides need GM adjudication.

Fire Pledge.effect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: At the End of the Round, Roll 2 Dice of Fire-Type Damage to everyone without immunity to Ground on the field ignoring defenses. Duration 4 Rounds.

Water Pledge.effect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battlefield: Add 2 Dice to all Chance Dice rolls of everyone in the field. Duration 4 Rounds.

Grass Pledge.effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Target's that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.

Mist.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.

Lucky Chant.effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Unique. Targets can Re-roll one un-successful die from all their rolls. Critical Hits do not grant Bonus dice against the Targets. Whole Scene Duration. Out of battle, good things happen at Storyteller's Discretion.

Court Change.effect: Target Battlefield. Swap any Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Effects on the Foe's side of the field (ie Tailwind, Grassy Terrain healing, Fire Pledge.) for those on the User's side.

MOVE-A57.scope: Thirteen held-item cards, using battle item units, final equipment validation, Unburden/Symbiosis follow-ups and Sticky Hold (which blocks theft, exchange and removal). Thief and Covet take the target's held item after damaging it if the user's hand is empty. Bestow gives the user's held item to a target that can hold it (the printed 'cannot be used if the Target is not holding an Item' contradicts giving it, so the coherent reading is applied: the target must be able to receive). Trick and Switcheroo exchange held items, or hand over the only one. Knock Off adds 2 damage dice against an item holder and knocks the item to the ground (recoverable after battle); Corrosive Gas and Embargo also remove held items that way, and Embargo stops items being used on the target for the scene. Incinerate destroys held items of those it damages. Bug Bite and Pluck eat a damaged target's berry and give its reviewed effect to the user; Pluck also adds 1 damage die against a berry holder. Stuff Cheeks applies its held berry's effect without consuming it, then raises Defense by 2. Teatime makes those affected eat their held berries without effect; berries in the Trainer's bag are not changed.

Thief.effect: Single Target. The User steals the Target's Held Item. If the User already has a Held Item, this effect fails.

Covet.effect: Single Target. The User steals the Target's Held Item. If the User already has a Held Item, this effect fails.

Bestow.effect: Single Target. Can't be used if Target is not holding an Item. The User gives its Held Item to the Target.

Trick.effect: Single Target. The User and the Target switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an Item, it gives it away.

Switcheroo.effect: Single Target. The User and the Target switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an Item, it gives it away.

Knock Off.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.

Corrosive Gas.effect: Area Attack. Those affected lose their held item.

Incinerate.effect: Single Target. All Foes in Range. Destroy the held item of those affected.

Embargo.effect: Single Target. The Target loses its Held Item. Target's Trainer & Partners can't use Items on the Target. Whole Scene Duration.

Bug Bite.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.

Pluck.effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding a Berry, Add 1 Die to the Damage pool of this Move. The User also eats the berry and gains its effects.

Stuff Cheeks.effect: Target Self. If the user has a held Berry, it gains its effects, afterwards, Increase User's Defense by 2. The Held berry can still be used as normal.

Teatime.effect: Area Move. Those Affected will eat their held berries and berries on their Trainer's Bag without gaining their effects. Outside of battle, it will diffuse violent intentions for a few minutes.

MOVE-A58.scope: Seven scene and consequence cards. Memento: the user faints (also when its Accuracy fails); the target's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense drop by 2 through ordinary stat protection, and the reductions that apply persist across switching for the scene. Springtide Storm: the owner saves 'Raise the user' (+1 Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, Sp. Defense) or 'Lower the targets' (Defense and Sp. Defense -2); three Chance dice (plus Serene Grace and Water Pledge) apply it on a 6. Synchronoise: the owner saves one type before damage and only targets with that type are affected. Nature Power takes its type, and Camouflage the user's type for the scene, from the surroundings recorded for Secret Power plus active terrains, using the printed energy table (p.530); when several types are possible the owner saves one. Pay Day and Make It Rain record money by trainer rank (Starter/Rookie 100, Standard 250, Advanced 500, Ace or more 1000): Pay Day for the user's trainer per hit, Make It Rain once for the user's and each hit Pokemon's trainer, and Make It Rain lowers the user's Special by 2. The app does not track money, so the totals are listed in the battle-end log.

Memento.effect: Single Target. The User faints. Reduce by 2 the foe's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.

Springtide Storm.effect: Area Move. Lethal. Low Accuracy 2. *Choose one: Roll 3 Chance Dice to increase by 1 the User's Strength, Special, Dexterity, Defense & Sp. Defense. Or, Roll 3 Chance dice to Reduce by 2 the affected Defense & Sp. Defense.

Synchronoise.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Choose one Type (Fire, Poison, Steel, etc.). This move only affects those with that Type.

Nature Power.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530

Camouflage.effect: Target Self. For the rest of the scene the User changes type to one that fits the terrain/ environment it is in (ie User is in a rocky cave, becoming rock type).

Pay Day.effect: Single Target. Ranged. At the end of the battle give Money to your Trainer Equal to their Rank: Starter/Rookie - 100 Standard - 250 Advanced - 500 Ace or more - 1000

Make It Rain.effect: Area Move. Reduce the User's Special by 2. At the end of the battle give the User and every Trainer whose Pokemon was hit, Money equal to their Rank: Starter/Rookie - 100 Standard - 250 Advanced - 500 Ace or more - 1000

MOVE-A59.scope: Seven copy moves. Copycat, Mirror Move and Instruct copy the last Pokemon move their target performed this battle (Instruct may name an ally); Assist copies any move known by an ally on the field or a member of the user's party, active or not; Me First copies the incoming non-Support move it reacts to, as a Reaction 1. These five are cast with the Cast copy control (CastCopy): the user names the copied move and may choose new targets, and the copied move uses its own Accuracy, damage and effects through the shared copied-cast pipeline, spending one action and recording the copy move as used. Unique, Max/Z, Sappy Seed and other copy moves cannot be copied. Mimic replaces itself with its target's last move for the scene (until the user leaves battle); Sketch replaces itself on the user's sheet permanently, as printed. A move the user already knows is not copied again.

Copycat.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.

Mirror Move.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.

Instruct.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.

Assist.effect: Target One Ally. Copy Move. Choose one Move known by an Ally or member of your party, who may or may not be active in battle. You may choose another Target(s) for the Move. Unique Moves can't be copied.

Me First.effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Copy Move. Support Moves can't be copied. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.

Mimic.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Replace "Mimic" with the copied Move. Whole Scene Duration.

Sketch.effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Replace "Sketch" with the copied Move. Permanent Duration.

ruling.review: Extracted definitions: Blocking prevents escape/recall/switching and Switcher effects; ongoing damage is 2 typeless dice, first source only. Duration p.77: round-duration effects cannot restart their counter while active; entry hazards affect new entrants only. Duration p.77: scene effects end when the affected Pokemon leaves battle. Powder p.81: Grass Pokemon take no damage or ill effects from Powder moves; MOVE-A39 applies this to Magic Powder.

snap_trap.decision: Printed prose and icons show scene Blocking only. Remove unsupported OngoingDamage metadata in the application correction layer.

fickle_beam.decision: Card supplies no separate power table. Retain JSON Special damage stat; printed Damage Pool says Strength plus X despite Special category.
